title: Time and Effort Knowledge Review — Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting
display_label: Time and Effort Knowledge Review — Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting
content:
Time and Effort Knowledge Review

From the ORA eTraining module "Show Your Work: Understanding Time and Effort Reporting" (lesson 7 of 8).
incorrect
Knowledge check: What is the primary purpose of effort reporting on federally sponsored projects?
  - To track payroll expenses in real time  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - To confirm that salary charges reasonably reflect actual work performed  [incorrect]
  - To ensure faculty meet teaching requirements  [incorrect]
  - To document fringe benefit rates  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which of the following best describes 100% effort?
  - 40 hours per week  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Total time spent on sponsored projects only  [incorrect]
  - Total institutional activities for which the individual is compensated  [incorrect]
  - Time spent only on federally funded activities  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A faculty member charges 50% of their salary to a federal grant but later certifies only 30% effort on that project. What is the issue?
  - No issue if salary was budgeted  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Salary overcharge to the grant  [incorrect]
  - Effort underreporting  [incorrect]
  - Fringe miscalculation  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which of the following is a key federal requirement for effort reporting?
  - Reports must be completed weekly  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Reports must be certified at least annually  [incorrect]
  - Reports must include detailed time logs  [incorrect]
  - Reports must be approved by the sponsor  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Effort is based on a standard 40-hour work week.
  - True  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - False  [incorrect]
  Explanation: Remember: Effort is based on total institutional activities, not hours.
Knowledge check: A PI certifies employee time and effort records without firsthand knowledge of time spent on the award. What is the primary concern?
  - Allowability  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Internal control weakness  [incorrect]
  - Payroll error  [incorrect]
  - Timing  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Institutional Base Salary (IBS) includes:
  - Outside consulting  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Institutional compensation  [incorrect]
  - Bonus payments  [incorrect]
  - Volunteer work  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Effort reporting ensures compliance with which section of Uniform Guidance?
  - 2 CFR 200.308  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - 2 CFR 200.430  [incorrect]
  - 2 CFR 200.306  [incorrect]
  - 2 CFR 200.334  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Effort certification must be:
  - Exact  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Reasonable estimate  [incorrect]
  - Hour-based  [incorrect]
  - Daily  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: What system is used by Morgan State University to facilitate effort certification?
  - Banner  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - SearchLight  [incorrect]
  - Argos  [incorrect]
  - Canvas  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which of the following is a major compliance risk?
  - Early certification  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Low effort  [incorrect]
  - Salary charged greater than effort performed  [incorrect]
  - Budget surplus  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: What should you do if you do not recognize an employee in SearchLight?
  - Certify anyway  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Ignore  [incorrect]
  - Delete record  [incorrect]
  - Report issue in SearchLight  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
